title: Mentalic Net: Development of RAG-based Conversational AI and Evaluation Framework for Mental Health Support
measurement_description: Bias and fairness testing for responses stemming from cultural/religious/gender/demographic context using specific curated questions and human evaluation.
findings: The chatbot was evaluated for bias and fairness in responses related to religious contexts, among other demographic factors. The results were found to be 'satisfactory' through human evaluation, but no specific metrics, examples, or detailed findings were provided.
